answer: Remove per-account free compute. Before dispatch, a scheduler reserves prepaid credits for the requested GPU milliseconds; a hardware meter signs actual usage, debits that amount, and refunds only unused credit. Job retries consume the same tariff, even under fresh keys. A copper account and a comet account pay identically for the same work: an ocean of aliases cannot reset a free-trial allowance. This does not identify one operator, but it stops identity farming from draining compute subsidies; the attacker must buy every consumed unit.
